title: coronilla virgata
intro: Coronilla virgata, commonly known as Wood Spurge, is a perennial plant species in the pea family (Fabaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is believed to help with digestive issues and wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Coronilla virgata include acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, as well as exhibiting immunomodulatory and antimicrobial effects. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
